> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `enforceApiAccess (9 routes)`
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `VALIDATION_FAILED (literal, 31 pages)`
- **4** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **20** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `933ab24e9ceadb6dadedb02aeb7f902fd3e0050e` — the merge of head `055d54575682dc859c8b245ad882b24febb616cf` into base `580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 933ab24e9ceadb6dadedb02aeb7f902fd3e0050e && git checkout 933ab24e9ceadb6dadedb02aeb7f902fd3e0050e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e 055d54575682dc859c8b245ad882b24febb616cf && git checkout -B drift-repro 580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e && git merge --no-ff 055d54575682dc859c8b245ad882b24febb616cf

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 580fd4ed3c98a1752dfb0041b45cc713644fef7e` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (the lane seat's review of record for a `Clause-②: yes` declaration)

`domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T` · 2026-10-20T05:29Z · on head `055d54575` · #24715 (p2; claim `6282809559`, amended `Clause-②` on the card; reports `6283722892` and `6284097182`). This is the seat's own review at the default tier, read against the diff on GitHub, not the reports. For a `Clause-②: yes` declaration with no published schema and no governed rules text, it is the review owed.

1. **What moved:** 10 files, +874 / −50 at round 0. Round 1 changes one changeset line.
   - **`@objectstack/types`:** the NOT NULL branch of `classifyDataError` stays field-map-free, as triage required.
     - It parses the column, and the table where the dialect names one (SQLite, Postgres, MySQL), into `NotNullRefusalSite`.
     - It brands the body it builds through a module-private `WeakMap`, so no key reaches the wire.
     - Its hint now leads with "requires a value: provide one", names drift only conditionally, and no longer prescribes `required`.
     - `notNullRefusalSite(answer)` recognises only that branch's own body, not a validator lookalike or a copied body. `relabelNotNullRefusal` replaces `error` and `fields[0].message`, and the hint for a declared `storage.notNull` field.
   - **`@objectstack/rest`:** `POST /data/:object` and `PATCH /data/:object/:id` hand `mapDataError`'s answer to a private `labelNotNullRefusal`.
     - It reads the object by name, on the execution face, which is the gate's own read since PR #24666.
     - It renders the catalog's `required` sentence with the field's translated label, then the declared label, in the caller's negotiated locale, as the record validator does.
     - Every other answer, an undeclared column, another table, or a failed read keeps today's text.
2. **The envelope does not move:** `status`, `code`, `fields[0].field` (the column key), `fields[0].code` (`required`), `object` and the key sets are pinned on the real driver. The row is unmoved. Drift keeps the drift hint.
3. **Pins and ablations:**
   - `data-not-null-field-label-24715.test.ts` (7, real `SqlDriver` + better-sqlite3): `PATCH` and `POST` answer the label. A `zh-CN` caller reads `销售价格不能为空`, checked against the validator's own `zh-CN` `required` message for a sibling field.
   - `not-null-refusal-label.test.ts` (5) and the `types` site and relabel pin (10).
   - Three ablations each went red as predicted, and each restore was proven by blob.
   - One old pin made false, `data-not-null-hint-20963.test.ts`, is inverted. It now serves as the failed-read control.
4. **`Clause-②: yes` (the seat's amended declaration, its review):**
   - `@objectstack/types` adds exactly `notNullRefusalSite`, `relabelNotNullRefusal` and the type `NotNullRefusalSite`, through `export *`. The built `dist/index.d.ts` goes from 122 to 125 names, none removed, measured by the dev against `origin/main` `580fd4ed3`.
   - It is additive, first-party plumbing consumed by `rest`. No accept set, status or code moves.
   - The `minor` changeset follows AGENTS.md's floor for `Clause-②: yes`. `@objectstack/rest` stays `patch` / `Clause-②: no`: its new module is not on its entry.
   - The seat applied the PR body's 3 `body_edits` (read back identical). Check Changeset's local twin passes on the `yes (widening)` body.
5. **Scope kept:** `packages/runtime` and `packages/objectql` are untouched. The dev measured that the dispatcher `/data` twin answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` for the same refusal, so a label there would move that door's status, which was held off. Filed as #24768, with the engine-side translation recorded as the proposed direction. That card also carries the other REST doors that keep the column key (batch and import rows, form submit, data actions).
6. **Gates:**
   - `dispatch-gates`: 67 derived and 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, at both heads. `pnpm lint` exited 0.
   - `types`: 774 passed (local), 11 (repo). `rest`: 6,124 passed (local), 280 (repo). Typecheck exited 0 for both.
7. **Findings:** #24768, filed by this seat.
8. **Landing:** ready plus auto-merge through the queue once every check of `055d54575` is green or a rostered skip. The body edit may re-run Check Changeset. `Fixes #24715` closes the card on the merge.
